title: DeciForm: Incorporating Task Structure into Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision models unify candidate selection, Boolean judgment, and numerical scoring within a single model. Their answer spaces nevertheless carry different structures: classification candidates form an unordered set, while numerical scores have an intrinsic order and distance. We introduce Deciform, which incorporates these distinctions into computation and supervision. Candidate-free queries and isolated candidate branches support consistent classification under reordering. A log--spherical objective trains candidate probabilities, while a decimal-prefix readout combines individual-value and interval-weighted cumulative supervision for numerical scoring. Shared adapters, task-private residuals, and output-channel gains support joint adaptation. On a shared 15,000-request test set, Deciform improves all three decision metrics on Qwen and ModernBERT; source-normalized errors support the Score gains across the data mixture. Canonicalized

translated_title: DeciForm：将任务结构融入决策模型
translated_abstract: 决策模型在单一模型中统一了候选选择、布尔判断和数值评分三类任务。然而，它们的答案空间具有不同的结构：分类候选构成一个无序集合，而数值评分则具有内在的顺序和距离。我们提出DeciForm，将这些结构差异融入模型的计算与监督之中。无候选查询与相互隔离的候选分支支持在候选重排序下保持一致的分类结果。对数-球面目标函数用于训练候选概率，而十进制前缀读出机制则将单值监督与区间加权累积监督相结合，用于数值评分任务。共享适配器、任务私有残差以及输出通道增益支持多任务的联合适配。在一个包含15,000个请求的共享测试集上，DeciForm在Qwen和ModernBERT上提升了全部三项决策指标；经来源归一化的误差分析支持了Score任务在各类数据混合下的改进效果。
tldr: DeciForm通过将答案空间的结构差异（分类的无序性与数值评分的有序性）融入计算与监督机制，使单一决策模型在候选选择、布尔判断和数值评分三项指标上均获得提升。
en_tdlr: DeciForm incorporates answer-space structural distinctions—unordered classification sets versus ordered numerical scores—into computation and supervision, improving all three decision metrics (candidate selection, Boolean judgment, and numerical scoring) in a single unified decision model.
